attribution.note: Zitron states and endorses the prediction in his own prose.

semantics.note: The categorical parenthetical denies a 2026 outcome. The surrounding hypothetical does not make that denial conditional.

contract.note: The contract preserves the forecast and acknowledges its ambiguity. A definitive test would require choosing between working chips and volume production, which the speaker did not specify.

evidence.note: This timely company disclosure reports working engineering samples. It challenges the prediction under a working-chip reading, but does not establish volume production. It is not an independent finding.

output.rationale: The undefined meaning of building the ASIC prevents a determinate verdict: working samples and volume production yield different tests. Independently, the 2026 deadline has not passed and the contract supplies no early-resolution rule. The disclosed samples cannot justify an early contradiction.
